# Securiq | AI Security Engineer

> Securiq is an autonomous AI Security Engineer providing continuous cloud security monitoring, threat investigation, and human-approved Terraform HCL patch synthesis with zero standing access.

## Core Capabilities

- [Overview](https://securiq.co/#hero): Autonomous AI security engineer for AWS, GCP, and Azure cloud infrastructure.
- [Workflow](https://securiq.co/#workflow): 6-step detection, investigation, Terraform HCL patch synthesis, and human approval flow.
- [Security & Trust Architecture](https://securiq.co/security): Read-only configuration analysis, ephemeral RAM execution, OIDC role assumption, and SOC 2 audit readiness.
- [Pricing & Plans](https://securiq.co/pricing): Flexible pricing tiers for startups and enterprise cloud engineering organizations.
- [Team & Leadership](https://securiq.co/team): Founders, AI researchers, and cloud systems architects building Securiq.
- [Contact Security Team](https://securiq.co/security#vendor-review): Direct channel for SOC 2 documentation, vendor security questionnaires, and vulnerability disclosure.

## Technical Specifications

- **Integration Mode**: Agentless cloud-native connection via AWS IAM / OIDC role assumption.
- **Data Plane Guarantee**: Zero access to customer application databases, object stores, or sensitive data payloads.
- **Remediation Method**: Formatted Terraform HCL pull requests requiring explicit human click-approval.
- **Execution Lifecycle**: Short-lived ephemeral session tokens that expire immediately upon task completion.
